about_disease.description: A very rare inherited multisystemic disease presenting non-specific neurological, hepatic, psychiatric or osseo-muscular manifestations due to excessive copper deposition in the body.

rule_text: Ordered by how strongly the proteins are linked to the disease. Pieces of the same machine count once. If a medicine acts on different machines, the scores are added. Ties: more reports first, then alphabetical. Being first on the list does not mean best.

proteins.function: A cytochrome P450 monooxygenase that catalyzes the side-chain hydroxylation and cleavage of cholesterol to pregnenolone, the precursor of most steroid hormones.

new_clues.ending: But there is a catch. Nobody knows from our information if the disease needs this protein turned up or down. So this is a clue to read about. Never start, stop or change any medicine without a doctor.
